headline: Your GTM has *6 pieces.*
rows: Who the customer should be~Do your last 10 wins share one profile?
Where to find them~Ask your last 3 customers where they first heard of you.
Message and packaging~Ask 3 people on your team what you sell.|Do the answers match?
Trust on LinkedIn~Open your leaders' profiles as a buyer.|Can you tell who they help?
Cold outreach~Take last month's replies.|Name the message and the list behind each.
One CRM~Pick a deal from last quarter.|Can you read every step from the CRM alone?
